title: Taking H₂@Home to the Provincial Stage
subtitle: Ontario Engineering Competition · Carleton University
paragraphs: After winning at Guelph, our team brought H₂@Home to the Ontario Engineering Competition alongside engineering students from across the province.
Presenting at a larger competition pushed us to look more closely at our design decisions, explain our technical approach, and think about how the idea could work beyond a prototype.
It was also a chance to meet other student engineers and see the range of ideas being developed across Ontario.
